Q: How should I pass user secrets from my frontend to my backend with Tauri? A:

From my point of view, something like a xss attack on your javascript side is more dangerous.

Tauri use IPC calls that are transported via os level pipelines rather than Internet protocols. Maybe hackers are only able to hack it through memory hooking.

By the way, you should disable webview debugger access for releases.

Q: Cannot run program ""C:\PROGS\java\Oracle\jdk-8"\bin\java" : CreateProcess error=5, Access is denied A:

You have defined an incorrect JAVA_HOME environment variable.

To see what value it has, enter a following command in CMD window:

echo %JAVA_HOME%

It will likely output a value enclosed in unnecessary quotes. Here is an example of a valid output on my workstation:

C:\Users\user>echo %JAVA_HOME%
C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-21.0.10.7-hotspot\

To temporarily change the value, issue commands:

set JAVA_HOME=C:\PROGS\java\Oracle\jdk-8\bin\java
mvn clean install

Q: Can't override windows key with tauri window focused A:

here's my approch:
On ur rust side, typically in ‘lib.rs’.

add .device_event_filter(tauri::DeviceEventFilter::Always); after tauri::Builder

e.g.:

tauri::Builder::default()
  .device_event_filter(tauri::DeviceEventFilter::Always);
